1924, September
FR. SOLANUS NOTEBOOK NO. 1
Page 15 Cont.
Sept. 12 Lost Mental Faculties Restored. Wilfrid J. Vincent Noonan (27 now in St. Joseph's Retreat Dearborn since June 15. Once a very successful student, seemingly called to be priest or religious, but to help poor parents decides on course of medicine -- and brakes down completely; is enrolled to-day for two years by bro- ken hearted mother
Oct. 24 Saw him To-day -- Naturally not much hope -- poor Mother weeps bitterly ...
Aug. 2nd Portiuncula 1925 now back home since March and first night intern Doctor in V -- Co's Hospital. Deo Grat. Loss of Mental Faculties Restored Indeed. Now Thanks be to God!
N.B. said W.J.N get his "degree M.D. in October 1927. In June 1928 is made Superintendent of big hospital in Detroit. Delray Hospital.
20 Francis Jones - Printer (36 3443 Parker) struggling for eight years to make ends meet has had holy masses said frequently in Hon. St. Anthony for success. Things have not succeeded To-day enrolls whole Family for year in S .M.A.
25 Matthew Richey 45 of 6563 Bewick - Enrolled by Catholic wife
27 Refuses to Receive Sacraments though in Dying Condition. Leo Wosch consumptive in Marine Hosp refuses this p.m. to listen to talk of going to confession - angry at proposal of his sister to do so -- Enrolled after fruitless efforts for year. Oct. 1 Happy & Appreciative, Receives Happy Death Oct. 4 Feast of
Oct.
1 Otto Brink 62 3818 lovett, 32 years acting toward wife and Fam as one possessed - to confession twice in that time Wife enroll- ess him and herself for year.
Page 16 Oct
6 Shugar Diabetes Cured. Joseph Kajeski 3320 Montgomery (35 yrs old) two years invalid with diabetes - in fact a hopeless case, is enrolled Sept. 3rd goes to work October 6th Deo Gr!
7 Margarit Buick - 32 722 St. Jean Enrolled Sept. 6th very much troubled with glasses, two specialists declar incurable optic- nerves. To-day reported perfect use of glasses. Declared won- derful Restoration Deo Gratias!
